evidence_snippets: Enable the data read setting for your Google Cloud project to record SIEM search queries run by users. chronicle.googleapis.com/feeds.get chronicle.googleapis.com/rules.list chronicle.googleapis.com/curatedRuleSets.countCuratedRuleSetDetections Logs with service name chronicleservicemanager.googleapis.com Google SecOps audit logs written using the chronicleservicemanager.googleapis.com service name are only available at the organization level, not at the project level.
